arguments.commit_message: fix: correct percentage typo and remove empty expr from JSON datasources
arguments.title: Fix Grafana dashboard schema and typo errors
arguments.description:
# What
Corrected a typo `percintage` to `percentage` across multiple dashboard panels and removed erroneous empty `expr` properties from JSON datasource panels.

# Why
Grafana dashboards contained errors in their definition files, potentially causing rendering issues or misconfigurations.

# Verification
Ran Grafana integration tests and added a UX report.

# Result
Cleaner dashboard JSON files and fixed typos.
